H01.description: Crate version bump that goes with the public API change to NpmPackumentFormat.

H02.description: Adds the chrono dependency that the new modified-date-based packument format selection needs.

H03.description: Head's packument format model ties the full packument to minimumDependencyAge alone. It always fetches full packuments for every package when minimumDependencyAge is set, even for packages last modified before the cutoff, and does not model the no-downgrade trust policy's need for the full packument. The fix's intent is partly an optimisation, so this reading is somewhat uncertain.

H04.description: Adds a doc comment to the download trait method.

H05.description: Adds a packument request format parameter to the HTTP client trait for the new format selection.

H06.description: Removes the unused packument format parameter from load_package_info as part of the format rework.

H07.description: Carries the cached modified date into SerializedCachedPackageInfo so the new format selection can use it.

H08.description: Updates the parameter type to the new NpmPackumentRequestFormat.

H09.description: Updates the comparison to the new NpmPackumentRequestFormat type.

H10.description: Renames the parameter so that full-packument detection can also use the response contents.

H11.description: Some registries ignore the Accept header and always return the full packument; head does not detect this, so it fails to record the full-packument marker and treats the cache entry as abbreviated.

H12.description: Keeps the manifest's modified date in the slimmed cache so the new format selection can decide when the full packument is needed.

H13.description: A malformed non-object `scripts` field in any version (e.g. an empty string) makes has_install_script return an error, so loading the entire packument fails.

H14.description: Adds tests for detecting a full packument that a registry sent unrequested.

H15.description: Adds tests for packument format selection, keeping the modified date and tolerating malformed scripts.

H16.description: Caller updated to pass the node_modules dir and package name to the validating symlink_package_dir.

H17.description: Removes the manual destination path join, since symlink_package_dir now builds and validates the path.

H18.description: Caller updated to the new symlink_package_dir signature.

H24.description: Caller updated to the new symlink_package_dir signature, so the member dependency alias gets validated.

H25.description: symlink_package_dir accepts arbitrary destination paths built from untrusted package names or aliases (e.g. `../outside`, absolute paths, `.deno`), so it can delete entries and create symlinks outside node_modules or over reserved directories.

H26.description: symlink_package_dir takes an unvalidated new_path and removes and replaces whatever is there, allowing path traversal through crafted package names or aliases.

H27.description: Adds a test that invalid package names are rejected.
